summary: CICS online Authorization Summary View screen. Displays a paginated list of pending-authorization summary records (from the IMS authorization database), optionally filtered by account/card, letting the user page through them and select one to view its details (COPAUS1C). Pseudo-conversational.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the first page of authorization summaries. On re-entry evaluate the key: PF3 return; PF7 page backward; PF8 page forward; Enter select a summary to view its detail. Return to CICS.
branches: EVALUATE EIBAID: PF3 / PF7 / PF8 / ENTER

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
paragraphs.pseudocode: If a summary row is selected, transfer to the detail-view program passing the selected authorization key.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: a selected authorization summary drills into its detail view.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next page of authorization summaries forward from the IMS database (applying any filter).
branches: loop until page full or end-of-db

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the previous page of authorization summaries backward from the IMS database.
branches: loop until page full or top-of-db

paragraphs.name: SEND-AUTHSUM-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the header and the summary rows and send the map.
